name: Popover
description: A small non-modal panel anchored to a button, for a short task like sharing.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown before the trigger text.

props.name: open / onOpenChange
props.description: Controlled state, so the body can close it.

props.name: align
props.description: Aligns the panel to the trigger's start or end edge. Default start.

a11y: A non-modal role="dialog" named by its title; the trigger has aria-expanded and aria-controls.
Opening moves focus into the panel; Escape closes it and returns focus; outside clicks and tabbing away close it.
